name: pandachef
description: Find, create and organise recipes, your pantry, shopping list and meal plan in PandaChef.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your PandaChef kitchen into the chat. Search your own recipe collection by cuisine, tag, cooking time or nutrition, and open any recipe as a card with a servings scaler and step-by-step method. Ask what you can cook with what is in your pantry: PandaChef matches your recipes against your stock and shows which ingredients you have and which are missing. Get recipe ideas tailored to your ingredients and preferences and turn the one you like into a complete recipe in your collection. Keep your shopping list in sync – add the missing ingredients of a recipe, check items off right in the chat, or send the list to Bring!. Plan your week by adding recipes to your meal plan and see it at a glance.

PandaChef only reads and changes the data in your own PandaChef account, and only when you ask. You connect your account through a secure sign-in; ChatGPT never sees your password, and you can disconnect at any time in the PandaChef settings.
defaultPrompt: Create a quick 20-minute pasta recipe and save it to PandaChef.
I have eggs, spinach and feta. Add them to my pantry and suggest a dish.
Suggest three quick vegetarian dinners for this week.

positive.description: Writes a recipe and saves it to the collection
positive.prompt: Create a quick 20-minute pasta recipe and save it to PandaChef.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the written recipe as a draft card, then saves it: the reply says it is in the PandaChef collection and links to it. Works on a new, empty account.

positive.description: Fills the pantry and suggests a dish
positive.prompt: I have eggs, spinach and feta. Add them to my pantry and suggest a dish.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the three items to the pantry and shows recipe proposals as cards. Nothing else is saved until the user picks a proposal.

positive.prompt: What can I cook with what's in my PandaChef pantry?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows recipe tiles from the demo account (e.g. Spaghetti aglio e olio) with how many ingredients are on hand and which are missing. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Opens one recipe as a card
positive.prompt: Show me my Spaghetti aglio e olio recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the recipe card with ingredients and steps; the servings buttons scale the amounts. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Shows and updates the shopping list
positive.prompt: Show my shopping list and check off the lemons.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the shopping list of the demo account (parsley, lemons, chickpeas) and marks lemons as done.

positive.prompt: What's on my meal plan this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Renders this week's meal plan with the planned recipes of the demo account by day.

positive.prompt: Give me recipe ideas with eggs, feta and tomatoes.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows several recipe proposals as cards with time, difficulty and calories. Nothing is saved until the user picks one and asks to create it.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: General cooking knowledge without the user's data
negative.prompt: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
Order me a pizza from the nearest restaurant.

publication.release_notes: New starter prompts that work on a new, empty account: write a recipe and save it, or fill the pantry and get a suggestion.

de-DE.subtitle: Rezepte, Inventar & Planer
de-DE.description:
Hol deine PandaChef-Küche in den Chat. Durchsuche deine eigene Rezeptsammlung nach Küche, Tag, Kochzeit oder Nährwerten und öffne jedes Rezept als Karte mit Portionsrechner und Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung. Frag, was du mit deinem Inventar kochen kannst: PandaChef gleicht deine Rezepte mit deinem Vorrat ab und zeigt, welche Zutaten du hast und welche fehlen. Lass dir Rezeptideen passend zu deinen Zutaten und Vorlieben vorschlagen und mach aus der besten ein vollständiges Rezept in deiner Sammlung. Halte deine Einkaufsliste aktuell – setz fehlende Zutaten eines Rezepts darauf, hake Einträge direkt im Chat ab oder schick die Liste an Bring!. Plane deine Woche, indem du Rezepte in den Planer legst, und behalte sie auf einen Blick im Griff.

PandaChef liest und ändert nur die Daten in deinem eigenen PandaChef-Konto, und nur, wenn du darum bittest. Du verbindest dein Konto über eine sichere Anmeldung; ChatGPT sieht dein Passwort nie, und du kannst die Verbindung jederzeit in den PandaChef-Einstellungen trennen.

es-ES.subtitle: Recetas, inventario y planes
es-ES.description:
Lleva tu cocina de PandaChef al chat. Busca en tu propia colección de recetas por cocina, etiqueta, tiempo de preparación o valores nutricionales, y abre cualquier receta como una tarjeta con calculadora de raciones e instrucciones paso a paso. Pregunta qué puedes cocinar con lo que tienes en tu inventario: PandaChef compara tus recetas con tus existencias y te muestra qué ingredientes tienes y cuáles faltan. Recibe ideas de recetas según tus ingredientes y preferencias y convierte la que más te guste en una receta completa de tu colección. Mantén al día tu lista de compras: añade los ingredientes que faltan de una receta, marca artículos directamente en el chat o envía la lista a Bring!. Planifica tu semana añadiendo recetas al planificador y tenla siempre a la vista.

PandaChef solo lee y modifica los datos de tu propia cuenta de PandaChef, y solo cuando tú se lo pides. Conectas tu cuenta mediante un inicio de sesión seguro; ChatGPT nunca ve tu contraseña y puedes desconectarla en cualquier momento en los ajustes de PandaChef.

fr-FR.subtitle: Recettes, inventaire et menus
fr-FR.description:
Apportez votre cuisine PandaChef dans le chat. Parcourez votre propre collection de recettes par cuisine, étiquette, temps de préparation ou valeurs nutritionnelles, et ouvrez chaque recette sous forme de fiche avec calcul des portions et étapes détaillées. Demandez ce que vous pouvez cuisiner avec votre inventaire : PandaChef compare vos recettes à vos réserves et indique les ingrédients que vous avez et ceux qui manquent. Recevez des idées de recettes adaptées à vos ingrédients et à vos préférences, puis transformez celle qui vous plaît en recette complète dans votre collection. Gardez votre liste des courses à jour : ajoutez les ingrédients manquants d’une recette, cochez des articles directement dans le chat ou envoyez la liste vers Bring!. Planifiez votre semaine en ajoutant des recettes au planificateur et gardez-la en un coup d’œil.

PandaChef ne lit et ne modifie que les données de votre propre compte PandaChef, et uniquement quand vous le demandez. Vous connectez votre compte via une connexion sécurisée ; ChatGPT ne voit jamais votre mot de passe et vous pouvez vous déconnecter à tout moment dans les paramètres de PandaChef.

it-IT.subtitle: Ricette, inventario e menù
it-IT.description:
Porta la tua cucina PandaChef nella chat. Cerca nella tua raccolta di ricette per cucina, tag, tempo di cottura o valori nutrizionali e apri ogni ricetta come scheda con calcolo delle porzioni e procedimento passo passo. Chiedi cosa puoi cucinare con il tuo inventario: PandaChef confronta le tue ricette con le tue scorte e mostra quali ingredienti hai e quali mancano. Ricevi idee di ricette adatte ai tuoi ingredienti e alle tue preferenze e trasforma quella che preferisci in una ricetta completa nella tua raccolta. Tieni aggiornato l’elenco della spesa: aggiungi gli ingredienti mancanti di una ricetta, spunta gli articoli direttamente nella chat o invia l’elenco a Bring!. Pianifica la settimana aggiungendo ricette al pianificatore e tienila sempre sotto controllo.

PandaChef legge e modifica solo i dati del tuo account PandaChef, e solo quando lo chiedi. Colleghi il tuo account con un accesso sicuro; ChatGPT non vede mai la tua password e puoi scollegarlo in qualsiasi momento dalle impostazioni di PandaChef.

tr-TR.subtitle: Tarifler, envanter ve plan
tr-TR.description:
PandaChef mutfağını sohbete taşı. Kendi tarif koleksiyonunda mutfağa, etikete, pişirme süresine veya besin değerlerine göre ara ve her tarifi porsiyon hesaplayıcılı, adım adım anlatımlı bir kart olarak aç. Envanterindekilerle ne pişirebileceğini sor: PandaChef tariflerini stoğunla karşılaştırır ve hangi malzemelerin elinde olduğunu, hangilerinin eksik olduğunu gösterir. Malzemelerine ve tercihlerine uygun tarif fikirleri al ve beğendiğini koleksiyonunda eksiksiz bir tarife dönüştür. Alışveriş listeni güncel tut: bir tarifin eksik malzemelerini ekle, öğeleri doğrudan sohbette işaretle ya da listeyi Bring!'e gönder. Tarifleri planlayıcıya ekleyerek haftanı planla ve tek bakışta gör.

PandaChef yalnızca kendi PandaChef hesabındaki verileri okur ve değiştirir, üstelik yalnızca sen istediğinde. Hesabını güvenli bir oturum açma ile bağlarsın; ChatGPT şifreni asla görmez ve bağlantıyı istediğin zaman PandaChef ayarlarından kesebilirsin.
